Results.ReviewText:
I bought The Master Touch 22" charcoal BBQ from weber earlier this summer and I'll always be sold on Weber products.  I previously had the first generation charcoal Weber for nearly 15 years until I thought it was time for an upgrade.  

The main difference between the first generation vs this one:
- The ventilation is more easily controlled in the Master Touch
- The handles are safer to manipulate
- I like the cover rest handle rather than burning the patio floor.  It was convenient when my balcony was made of concrete but now that I have a composite deck, I can't rest the cover on the floor with my old BBQ.

The only thing I wish was available is a heavy duty cover for this model.  The only one available is a light cover and it only attaches from one corner.  With stronger winds, the top actually comes off from underneath on the other unattached side.

Overall, very pleased and I also use a natural starter with the chimney.  BBQs are very good!
Results.Title: Perfect grill!

Results.ReviewText:
I love the added height, the built in thermometer, the cool touch air vent, and easy slide lid.  I am less fond of the grate with the removable center piece; it makes it difficult to scrape.  Furthermore, unlike the traditional grate, I need a table to hold it while the grill warms up; I cannot hang it on the rim of the bowl otherwise the center falls on the ground.  I will probably end up replacing it with the standard hinged grate which is frustrating considering the price point.  Also, the warming rack is superfluous; it ends up getting in the way more than anything.  The jury is still out for me regarding the coal holders for between the grates.  During standard cooking (burgers, sausages, etc...), I have gone back to dumping the coals on one side of the grill and leaving the other side empty.  I see the potential value for longer cooks/roasts but need to try them more to determine their usefulness.  However, having learned how to cook on a kettle grill by simply shoveling all the coals to one side, it might be difficult to adjust.  

In summary: the added height, cool touch air vent, sliding lid, and especially color (I found an Ocean Blue) make me satisfied with this grill.  The added features (grate with removable center, charcoal bins, and warming rack) seemed nice at the time, but upon using them they are less than functional and might even get thrown away; the grill grate is especially frustrating.
Results.Title: Mostly satisfied with constructive criticism

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your comments and feedback regarding the GBS center insert falling out. We have passed this along.  If the grate is removed for any reason we suggest laying it on a flat surface instead of hanging it off the side of the grill. The grate is made with hinged sides to assist with adding more charcoal during a cook, instead of removing the whole grate to do so. We also designed the grate with the removeable center to make it easy to swap out for other GBS inserts if needed. Please look for an email from us to discuss this further. Thank you!

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
